name: hover-card
useFor: Use to preview what a link or an agent handle points to (the agent's addresses, its channels) for people with a pointer. Keep the same information reachable by clicking: hover cards do not open on touch.
constraints: Actions that exist only inside the card
A card that opens instantly on hover
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the raised white panels and the avatar tile, with the shared popup radius
title: Hover Card
description: A raised white preview card with 16px corners that opens after a short pause on a link or handle.
